iud.e: The Philippine sense is due to the streetfood being reminiscent of an intrauterine device.

iunno.e: Loose pronunciation of I dunno (“I don't know”).

d.g: A member of the Iu Mien people, a Southeast Asian subset of the Yao people, a minority group originally from China.
The language of the Iu Mien people.
The principle that a judge should base their decision on the strength of the arguments rather than their quantity.

iudex non calculat.e: Unadapted borrowing from Latin iūdex nōn calculat (literally “a judge does not calculate”).

d.g: Parties to a legal dispute do not need to plead or prove the law that applies to their case.

iura novit curia.e: Borrowed from Latin iura novit curia. Literally, “the court knows the law”.
